cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My forecast said sunny. I meant your face when the refund arrived. I taught you to look at the whole trip, not just the weather.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The holiday was ruined by rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've linked the cause to the result this time. No rain, no refund. That brighter ending is exactly what I told you to expect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the next trip we'd pay for with this refund. You used to read one line of my packing lists and stop. Keep the bottle; tell me I planned further ahead than you did.

reason: Make actual pupil instruction, correction and qualified praise affect the exact Drive. Replace analytical ending with disclosure, reciprocal question, planned next action, claimed prediction evidence or explicit changed-term comparison.
